title: Porter Nix, Keeper of the Wrong Welcome
summary: Read the local announcements and choose how to interrupt a performance that has forgotten its guests.
overview: One tank, one healer and one operator can handle the assignments. Extra members may help. No particular class or special offering is required.
Only one urgent warning runs at a time, followed by at least ten seconds of recovery. Keep attacking; the encounter has no compulsory long invulnerability scene.
A timed interaction starts from the labeled control. Remain nearby and still until it completes; movement or leaving cancels it. Ordinary incidental damage does not cancel the action.

roles.label: Tank
tips: Keep the boss on the reviewed same-floor camp and leave controls accessible. Summoning is disabled during required movement.

roles.label: Healer
tips: Use the clearly announced recovery periods. The operator does not need a second tank for stationary helpers.

roles.label: Operator
tips: Use the fixed labeled control or the printed alternative. No tiny moving target or simultaneous distant control is required.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Read the named safe ground and full countdown. Friendly guests cannot be harmed.

phases.label: Welcome and luggage
phases.description: At 70% and 35% health, an oversized case announces its departure. Destroy or control the case, or begin the three-second interaction at HOLD LUGGAGE. Finish within the displayed 18-second window. Success briefly interrupts the porter; a missed case produces one bounded impact.

abilities.name: Welcome and luggage
description: At 70% and 35% health, an oversized case announces its departure. Destroy or control the case, or begin the three-second interaction at HOLD LUGGAGE. Finish within the displayed 18-second window. Success briefly interrupts the porter; a missed case produces one bounded impact.

sections.title: Entry and practice
paragraphs: The native group leader requests this journey from the House Usher in public Plane of Mischief with three to six eligible characters of level 60 or higher. Review the labeled controls while the room is quiet, then confirm the challenge separately.

sections.title: Wipes and saved return
bullets: An unfinished fight resets after ten seconds without a living eligible engaged participant in its arena. Completed chapters stay complete.
Use the original expedition's guide after a native DZ Manager rejoin. Its original 24-hour expiry and replay deadline continue.
Cleared staging points remain reachable; checkpoint travel never places a returning member into an active arena.

notes: Local source and fixture checks do not establish installed-client presentation or live combat acceptance.
Exact optional discovery sequences and the final story reveal remain in operator material.

Published after a source review of the private version-34 House encounter catalog. Public journal metadata preserves the finale and optional-adventure spoiler settings; live deployment and combat balance remain unverified.
